sourceInventory.quote: Isolate standby pump P-6 and clear the skid for refurbishment.
Pump isolated, disconnected, and lifted clear.
Residue cleaned from the drain pocket.
An oily film reappeared in the drain pocket after cleaning.
Its origin has not been established.
The pump remains isolated.
Skid refurbishment can continue under isolation; return to service requires investigation of the recurring film.
Isolation permit IP-P6-908
Trace the recurring oily film and record the result before return to service.
One pump isolated; approximately 150 mL residue collected
Isolation certificate IP-P6-908 and maintenance photograph MP6-0801 recorded
Set the replacement pump after bearing-face acceptance and confirmed shim detail.
Bearing face cleaned and leveling points surveyed.
Replacement pump remained in the laydown zone.
The crew received verbal clearance at 08:05.
No signed bearing-face release had reached the crew by the end of this shift.
Pump setting deferred for this shift pending the written bearing-face release and confirmation of the shim stack.
Work package WP-P6; technical query TQ-061
Provide the signed bearing-face release and the issued shim detail to the installation crew.
Pump installed: 0; surveyed bearing points: 6
Chargehand shift log and survey sheet SV-P6-09
Coordinate inspection and installation readiness.
Inspection telephone call held at 07:50; delivery slot moved to the next shift.
Foreperson notes say QC passed.
This was a telephone update; the signed bearing-face sheet was awaiting issue at 14:30.
The mechanical crew reported that its written release had not arrived.
The existing M-214 revision B shows a 6 mm shim stack, while the replacement supplier sketch shows 9 mm.
Setting held while the bearing-face sheet and applicable shim detail are confirmed.
TQ-061; M-214 revision B; supplier sketch SK-P6-04
Confirm the applicable shim detail through TQ-061 and distribute the signed bearing-face sheet.
Existing detail: 6 mm; supplier proposal: 9 mm
Telephone coordination note CN-P6-09; survey sheet SV-P6-09
Obtain designer decision and prepare the grout delivery.
Engineer circulated an internal draft proposing the 9 mm stack.
Grout delivery accepted into the locked store.
Pump setting did not start.
The internal draft has not been issued by the designer through the document register.
The installer has received no approved revision.
Pump setting deferred for a second shift; release sheet and issued design detail were awaited at the start of the shift.
No project completion-date effect has been calculated.
TQ-061 awaiting issue; draft M-214 revision D
Issue the signed TQ-061 response with the drawing revision and obtain installation-crew receipt.
22 sealed grout bags received under delivery GR-462
Internal draft email and stores receipt GR-462
Complete bearing-face inspection.
Bearing-face inspection accepted at 10:20.
Signed release BF-P6-0910 uploaded to the work package and received by the installation chargehand at 10:42.
Bearing-face preparation acceptance is closed.
This inspection covers bearing-face condition only; anchor torque requires its own witness and acceptance.
Bearing-face release complete.
Pump setting also requires the issued shim detail and anchor-torque acceptance.
Request the separate anchor-torque witness before placing grout.
Six bearing points accepted
Signed bearing-face release BF-P6-0910 uploaded with inspector signature
Complete anchor torque and prepare setting operations.
Anchors torqued to the work-package values.
Witness requested for the afternoon.
Pump remained in the laydown zone at 11:30.
Anchor torquing by the installer is complete, but inspector witness acceptance has not yet been entered.
The crew still awaits the issued shim revision at 11:30.
Grouting remains dependent on separate anchor-torque acceptance and receipt of the design instruction.
Torque work sheet TW-P6-11; TQ-061
Obtain anchor-torque witness acceptance before grouting.
Eight anchors torqued
Installer torque sheet TW-P6-11; witness request WR-P6-11
Issue the final design instruction and check grout stores.
Signed TQ-061 response and drawing M-214 revision D issued at 13:10, specifying the 9 mm shim stack.
Installation chargehand acknowledged receipt at 13:35.
The issued instruction supersedes the earlier 6 mm detail; TQ-061 is closed.
The stores check lists 22 bags received, 19 issued to the installer for the next day's grouting, and two sealed bags returned to the main store.
One bag is unaccounted for in the transfer log.
Design information is released for installation.
Stores reconciliation remains open.
TQ-061 closed; M-214 revision D; transfer ST-P6-11
Reconcile the one-bag difference against store transfers and recorded usage.
22 received; 19 issued for grouting; 2 sealed bags returned; 1 bag unreconciled
Signed response TQ-061, revision D drawing, and receipt acknowledgement filed; stores transfer ST-P6-11
Set and grout the replacement pump, then protect the grout during its specified cure.
Pump set at 07:40 and grouting completed at 09:10 using M-214 revision D with the 9 mm stack.
Nineteen grout bags mixed.
Crew erected the cure barrier and posted a release time of 2026-09-14 09:10.

Preliminary coupling alignment measured 0.18 mm vertical offset against the work-package acceptance limit of 0.10 mm; final alignment remains required before start-up.
Physical pump setting and grouting are complete after the earlier deferrals.
Grout cure is proceeding to the specified release time.
Pump remains isolated for final alignment and start-up checks.
Principal Contractor records that an access notice was sent to instrumentation on 2026-09-11.
M-214 revision D; TQ-061 closed; AT-P6-0912; alignment sheet AL-P6-12
Link the signed anchor-torque acceptance and complete final alignment after cure before start-up.
19 grout bags mixed; preliminary vertical offset 0.18 mm; acceptance limit 0.10 mm
Grout batch sheet GB-P6-12 and preliminary alignment sheet AL-P6-12; signed AT-P6-0912 sheet not linked
Terminate instruments on the adjacent service rack.
Skid access restricted from 09:00 to 10:20 during grouting.
Three technicians worked in the panel room during the restriction and returned to the rack at 10:20.
The shift log does not establish whether this chargehand received the advance access notice.
No lost full shift or project completion-date change is recorded.

The cure barrier affects only the pump skid; service-rack access is available.
